projects.title: Short Public Text Classification
bullets: Compared classification errors across document lengths for short public question-category texts using Python, scikit-learn, and pandas in a supervised undergraduate course project.
Documented the training and test splits used for classifying short public text documents as an assigned project contribution.

projects.title: Reproducible Scientific Table Processing
bullets: Assembled a scripted data-cleaning workflow for public scientific tables in a supervised graduate course project using Python, pandas, and Git.
Recorded software dependencies and reproduced summary tables from raw inputs as assigned contributions to the public bibliographic analysis workflow.
